lines: Pedaling a bike on a midsummer night
A ponytail fluttering in the sea breeze
Dive into the pre‑dawn sky
More than the heroes of the manga I read long ago
Even though I should have grown up by now
How long has it been since then
I wonder how far I’ve moved forward
It’s wonderful precisely because it can’t be fulfilled
That’s probably how it is
The dream I drew drifts farther away
Let’s set off on the rusted bicycle
Twilight Line
All my heart blurs
Even the dream that seems about to be left behind
Stumbling, wounded, midway through life
I just keep pedaling
The candy shop that collapsed before I knew it
An empty park, the ruins of a liquor store
Only the shrine remains, left behind as it was
The feel of a sweat‑soaked dress shirt
The noisy hills where cicadas sing
They become nothing but a nuisance
It’s beautiful because it can’t be returned
Let’s just call it that
The pedals only spin uselessly in the past
That’s all— I have to go now
Twilight Line
All the future blurs
I already have enough righteousness
Midway through a life I keep resisting
I still don’t need any signposts
Twilight Line
Opening up the whole world
If it’s a future that isn’t anyone’s
Rolling onward on the sloping road
Now the night is breaking
